name: Escitalopram
summary: Escitalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) medication. This profile remains research-only while molecule-specific efficacy, safety, interaction, age-specific, and regulatory evidence is assembled and reviewed.
description: Canonical escitalopram entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until molecule-specific scientific evidence, pediatric and adult indication boundaries, interaction, and regulatory provenance has passed the site’s review gates.
safety_notes: U.S. prescribing information carries a boxed warning about suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients and includes serious warnings for serotonin syndrome, discontinuation symptoms, abnormal bleeding, hyponatremia, seizures, and activation of mania or hypomania. This summary is not exhaustive; consult current product-specific prescribing information.
